chunks: And with this documentation, he said:
God’s Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Do not hire foolish or blear-eyed women to breastfeed your babies, for the milk affects [the child]."

key_terms.العَمشاء: Blear-eyed woman (often interpreted as having defects in eyes or temperament)

ai.seo_question: Why should one avoid hiring foolish women as wet nurses according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the Shia concept of *al-ibadah* (transmission), where a wet nurse’s physical and intellectual traits are believed to influence the child’s character and health. It reflects the practical medical and spiritual concerns of early Islamic society regarding the selection of caregivers to ensure the upbringing of virtuous offspring.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: God’s Prophet (S) said, “Do not hire foolish or blear-eyed women to breastfeed your babies since breastfeeding affects the baby.”
